method: Built-in imagegen creates new reference-guided thermal base color and corresponding tangent normal; ordinary SDK texture conversion to DDS. Native material tint preserves gray/orange livery. Small ORM/mask maps are authored channel data.
reference_scope: Thermal tiles, flush access panels, restrained roughness; not a photograph pasted onto the hull.
donor_part: Tachi main bell component192 and contained components; native UVs/normals/materials retained
